newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares get helping hand from VA Stahl.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares get helping hand from VA Stahl.

text.p: Austrian shares edged 0.7 percent higher in light trade on Monday, helped by gains in steelmaker VA Stahl after investment house Merrill Lynch recommended the stock a 'buy'.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed at 1,076.59 -- 7.65 points up on the day but off the session high of 1,080.49.
"There was good buying for VA Stahl, that gave us something to work with," said a broker.
VA Stahl was the day's most actively traded share and the biggest gainer, advancing 14.2 schillings, or 4.1 percent, to 359.2 on 65,719 lots.
"The market started off well enough but it seemed to run out of steam as the session went on," said another dealer. He saw the ATX locked in a 1,060 to 1,085 points range.
Selective buying interest was reported for engineering group VA Technologie, industrial group Radex and Creditanstalt bank ordinary shares.
Wolford was the session's biggest decliner, slipping 42 schillings, or 2.9 percent, to 1,404 schillings.
November ATX futures stood 11.3 points up at 1,080. the broad-based Vienna bourse index gained 1.93 points to close at 412.33. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
